datasets.description: Order-book simulations generated by this repository's engine (implemented in M2; exploratory runs only so far).

generator.version: market 0.0.0 at the code revision recorded in each run_manifest.json
generator.parameters: experiments/configs/*.json; resolved per-run config in each results/*/runs/<run_id>.json

datasets.status: implemented; exploratory outputs under results/exploratory/ (development seeds 1-40)

datasets.description: Benchmark Dataset for Mid-Price Forecasting of Limit Order Book Data with Machine Learning Methods (Ntakaris, Magris, Kanniainen, Gabbouj, Iosifidis). NASDAQ Nordic Helsinki, five stocks, ten trading days (1 to 14 June 2010), 10:30 to 18:00; one column per block of 10 order-book events; normalised features.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), per the Metax record (access type Open, rights holder BigDataFinance); attribution required
datasets.bundled_reason: archive 1.86 GB, above the 20 MB commit limit of the owner's rules; download script instead

archive.sha256_source: Metax record checksum (checked 2018-06-26 by Fairdata) and recomputed locally 2026-11-24: identical

datasets.schema: 149 rows x N columns of whitespace-separated floats; rows 1..4 = level-1 ask price, ask volume, bid price, bid volume (only rows used); decimal-precision prices (tick 0.0001 = one cent at a scale factor of 100)
datasets.transformations: market.realdata.ingest: level-1 quotes, exclusions, segmentation into 5 stocks (jump threshold 0.1); reference units = blocks of 9,000 columns; statistics per unit (protocol section 12, R1)
datasets.personal_data: none (order books of five listed companies)
datasets.derived_committed: results/exploratory/REAL-REF/reference.json (per-block aggregate statistics; reference split only) and the reference values in experiments/realdata/EXP-005.json
datasets.status: adopted for EXP-005 (descriptive comparison); not used for calibration
